summary: USA Rare Earth Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing Amendment No. 1 to its preliminary proxy statement regarding its pending acquisition of SVRE Holdings Ltd. (Serra Verde) via merger. Under the Merger Agreement dated April 19, 2026, SVRE will merge into Middlebury Merger Sub Ltd., a wholly owned subsidiary, with the sub surviving. The filing includes updated unaudited pro forma financials for periods ending March 31, 2026 and December 31, 2025. No price terms, premium, or advisor are disclosed. The deal is subject to shareholder vote and SEC review. Watch for regulatory clearance and shareholder approval milestones.
